name: Mooorder
summary:
Mooorder is a logic-puzzle mystery game built to be played live, with a host solving each case on stream while the audience follows the deduction board in real time. Every case is a short murder mystery with a cast of suspects, a set of possible weapons and locations, and a list of clues. Marking a grid as they go, players rule out combinations one at a time until a single suspect, weapon and location remain, then name the culprit to see whether they cracked the case.

The cases get harder as they go, adding motives, more suspects and statements from each suspect, in which the culprit always lies. Some clues point to documentary evidence to examine, and a sealed extra clue can be opened when a case gets stuck.
